title: Arequipa Walking City Tour
short_description: Discover Arequipa's Historic Center on an approximately 4-hour walking tour through its squares, colonial architecture and major cultural attractions.
long_description: Walk through the Historic Center of Arequipa to discover the history, architecture and culture of the White City. Visit the Plaza de Armas, its arcades, white volcanic-stone buildings and the renowned Santa Catalina Monastery. A relaxed and engaging cultural experience.
price_note: Price per person. Ask about rates and availability.

days.title: Day 1: Arequipa Walking City Tour
days.text: Begin with hotel pickup and walk through the Historic Center of Arequipa. Visit the emblematic Plaza de Armas, its arcades and sillar buildings. Continue to Santa Catalina Monastery and other colonial spaces while your guide shares the history and identity of the White City. The tour ends after approximately four hours.
